text:
wonderful idea. I thought UPDATE. These work fine...they are very solid cubes. like a heavy brick! they don't splinter. silicone ice cube tray....wonderful idea. I thought, finally, easy cube removal.

BUT....the being soft and very pliable, as intentionally designed, is also, unfortunately, one of its downfalls. hard to fill and get into the freezer without it flexing and spilling water. oh, sure, you could say, don't fill them up so much. well, that's the other downfall to this good idea. the cubes are much smaller than regular sized cubes from plastic trays. these cubes are only 1 inch square. about half the size of a regular cube.

I tried to return them, but I believe I found them on Todays deal or other deal where there is no return. :/

product_metadata.title: Perfect Size Silicone Ice Cube Tray, Set of 2, FREEZERS",No Odor or Aftertaste!
